name: Plank to Push-Up
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with a straight body line.
Place one hand on the floor, then the other, pressing up to a push-up position.
Lower back down to your forearms, one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep. Keep the hips level — no rocking.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Plank to Push-Up is an intermediate core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
